name: PageFluent – Smooth Page Transitions & Loader
author: WPJutsu

sections.description:
Your website deserves to feel as good as it looks.

Most WordPress sites suffer from jarring, instant page jumps. PageFluent
replaces those with fluid transitions and elegant loaders — turning every
click into a polished experience that keeps visitors engaged.

See live demos of all transitions →
Documentation & video tutorials →

Free version — Get started in minutes

Transitions

  • Fade
  • Slide to Top
  • Slide to Right
  • Slide to Bottom
  • Slide to Left
  • Glassmorphism
  • Custom color for every transition

Loaders

  • Spinner
  • Dots
  • Bars
  • Progress Bar
  • Pulse
  • Custom color for every loader

General

  • Live preview stage — see your settings before publishing

Pro version — Full creative control

Transitions

  • 15+ premium transition effects — including Circle from click, following your visitor’s cursor
  • Arrival & departure transitions (separate in/out animations)
  • Fine-tune timing & easing (5 motion curves)

Loaders

  • 13+ loader styles — including a live percentage counter
  • Use your own logo or image as a loader, branding your website !
  • Animate your logo (pulse, breathe, spin, bounce) and set its size

General

  • Play transitions only on the first visited page
  • Conditional rules — disable on mobile, on WooCommerce checkout, cart & my account, or on any URL pattern
  • Priority support

Upgrade to PageFluent Pro →
sections.installation:
From the WordPress dashboard (recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded .zip file
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. A new PageFluent menu item will appear in your dashboard

Via SFTP

  1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate from the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard
sections.faq:
Does my theme need to support a specific hook?

Yes — your theme must include the wp_body_open() function call right
after the opening <body> tag. Most modern themes support this. If
transitions don’t appear, that’s the first thing to check.
See how to verify →

Will PageFluent slow down my site?

No. All animations run client-side and are designed to have minimal
impact on performance. Transitions actually mask loading time, which
can improve perceived speed.

Do I need to know how to code?

Not at all. Everything is configured from a simple settings panel.
Documentation and video tutorials
are available if you need guidance.

What are the minimum requirements?

WordPress 6.0+ and PHP 8.1+.

Where can I report a bug or request a feature?

Use the support forum on WordPress.org
for the free version, or contact us directly at
wp-jutsu.com for Pro support.
sections.changelog:
2.0.1 – july 29, 2026

  • PageFluent now works right after activation — a fade transition is enabled by default on new installs (existing settings are never touched)
  • New status indicator in the settings topbar: see at a glance whether effects are live, and switch them on or off from any tab
  • Enabling transitions or loaders now turns the plugin on automatically instead of saving silently with nothing happening
  • Warning on the Plugins screen when PageFluent is installed but no effect is running, with a one-click Enable button
  • Fixed: the Settings link was missing from the Plugins screen in the Pro version

2.0.0

  • Complete admin redesign — dark UI with a permanent live preview stage
  • Custom colors for transitions and loaders are now FREE
  • New Pro: easing presets (Smooth, Snappy, Spring, Ease in-out, Linear)
  • New Pro: animated custom logo (pulse, breathe, spin, bounce) with adjustable size
  • New Pro: conditional rules — disable on mobile, on WooCommerce checkout, cart & my account, or on any URL pattern
  • New Pro transitions: Split screen, Blinds, Circle from click (expands from the visitor’s click)
  • New Pro loaders: Comet ring, Orbit, live Percentage counter

1.2.2 – june 16, 2026

  • Minor changes readme

1.2.1 – may 26, 2026

  • WordPress 7.0 compatibility check

1.2.0 – may 07, 2026

  • Add the preview button to open a modal and see configuration
  • Global CSS changes in admin UI
  • Add locked pro features in transitions & loaders
  • Exclusion mailto: / tel: / javascript: links in triggers transitions
  • Add fallback to color-mix() for old navigators

1.1.0 – march 05, 2026

  • Add a new transition : Glassmorphism
  • Add the review link

1.0.2 – january 27, 2026

  • Minor changes in assets / readme

1.0.1 – january 27, 2026

  • Change assets

1.0.0 – january 27, 2026
